text: いろいろな　ボタンを　よくつかう　じゅんばんで　せつめい　します。

structure.jp: いろいろな　ボタンを
よくつかう　じゅんばんで

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よくつかう　じゅんばん
patterns.explanation: A plain verb before a noun describes that noun. よくつかうじゅんばん = 'the order of often using'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で says the way or method something is done. じゅんばんで せつめいします = 'I explain in that order'.
